scope: existing public dev trees (bounded-expand-dev-r1); not a holdout; warm cache; one machine

dev026.order: round 0: layouts in listed order, codecs in listed order; round 1: the whole point list reversed
per_point: verify OUT TREE (timed: full decode + byte check)
checks: same archive SHA in both rounds
max frame raw bytes <= frame limit
analysis: per class and layout: size, encode / verify / extract wall per round
size-time Pareto set (non-dominated by size and encode wall)
smallest archive within the encode-time budget of each Zstd level on the whole layout
extract index split: index_read / index_manifest from extract-profile

dev027.batches: order by sha256('dev027-batch:' + path); cumulative byte shares 40 / 55 / 70 / 85 / 100 % (closest prefix, whole files)
per_recipe: then 4x: recipe-append (keep recipe) + verify, recipe-pack of the cumulative tree (fresh rebuild) + verify
checks: old archive is a byte prefix of each append
analysis: append size / fresh size per generation
cumulative append wall vs one fresh rebuild per step
old archive bytes copied per append and in total

execution: India vps-in1 via in-long-task, exclusive; one command at a time; measured child pinned to one CPU; timeout 3600 s per command
